review_scope: Selection-relevant native controls, producer bodies, mapped API wrappers and named detail bindings; not a full code audit or proof of whole-project absence.

rows.reason: Customer native create includes email/name/customer identity; mapped edit forwards name but not email. Identity, nested addresses and enum fields excluded.
Metric detail supports archive and readonly display; mapped API has create/get/delete/status archive, no text edit binding.
Charges/features step delegates nested components, recurring charges and feature selections to the parent plan payload.
Visible name/description controls; mapped CreatePlan serializes plan_name, enum duration and nested initial_version, not description as a second top-level text property.
Version step supplies nested initial_version fields; localized_name is one free-text value alongside enum/numeric/relationship controls.
FeatureForm creates feature_name/feature_description or selects existing features; mapped Features API has create/get, no text-edit binding.
Adds an enum currency version, not two text properties.
Deletion confirmation, no create/edit pair.
Recurring charge callback has one name text plus amount and enum timing/behavior; parent stores nested recurring charges.
Selects an existing customer relationship.
Component callback contains metric selection, tiers and interval/prepaid values; parent serializes nested components, not a standalone two-text resource.
Version activation and migration options are Boolean/enum operations.
Organization form has organization_name and enum industry, not two text properties.
Pricing unit creation has code/name/symbol; mapped PricingUnits wrapper only creates/lists, no native edit binding established.
Add-on creation has addon_name/addon_description; inspected native details display both without edit controls, and mapped AddOn API lacks text-update operation.
Backtest payload has one backtest_name text, generated dates, fixed KPI and nested substitutions.
Credit creation has one description text alongside amount/date/currency/relationship values.
CreatePlan sends plan_name, enum plan_duration, nested initial_version and optional external identity links; no second independent top-level text.
Reviewed handlers create plan versions/custom/currency/backtest configurations; no same-resource two-text continuation established for native CreatePlan payload.
Loads plan/version and delegates to EditPlan; no independent mutation form.

unresolved: Missing native edit bindings for feature/pricing-unit/add-on candidates do not prove global absence.
No runtime or source/package identity qualification performed.
